# Test Prompt: Rare Formats Generate one response that reproduces every construct below, in this order. Keep the markdown syntax. Do not wrap the whole answer in one fence. ## Footnotes The boiling point needs a citation[^rare]. [^rare]: Measured at standard pressure, 100 degrees Celsius. ## Task list and strikethrough - [x] Calibrated the scale - [ ] Recheck the blank The previous label was ~~obsolete~~ and should not be used. ## Autolinks, bare URLs, and a markdown link Autolink: Bare URL: https://example.com/rare-bare-url/with/a/long/path See the [lab notes](https://example.com/rare-docs) for the procedure. ## Inline HTML First line.
Second line after an explicit break. The ion is written Na+ in running text.
Instrument noteThe cuvette was rinsed twice.
## Nested blockquote with a list and code > Outer observation from the bench. > > > - nested aliquot > > - nested blank > > > > ```js > > const nested = true > > ``` ## Table with alignment, inline math, and a pipe | left | center | right | pipe | | :--- | :---: | ---: | :--- | | $\alpha$ | $x^2$ | $1$ | a \| b | ## Wide table | c1 | c2 | c3 | c4 | c5 | c6 | c7 | c8 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | ## Mermaid fence ```mermaid graph TD A[Start] --> B[End] ``` ## Chemistry and display environments KaTeX on this site does not load the mhchem extension, so this must still be attempted: $\ce{H2O}$ and $\ce{SO4^{2-}}$ $$ \begin{cases} x & \text{if } x \ge 0 \\ -x & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases} $$ $$ \begin{aligned} x + y &= 5 \\ 2x - y &= 1 \end{aligned} $$ Boxed: $\boxed{E = mc^2}$ Unicode inside text: $\text{温度 25°C}$ ## Emoji, RTL, and CJK Status emoji: ✅ and 🧪.
